PRIVACY POLICY
This notice describes how Akin Wallet handles information when you use its Android application. Akin Wallet is developed by John Deniel Santos Dela Peña. Privacy enquiries may be sent to johndenieldelapena97@gmail.com.

PURPOSE AND SCOPE
Akin Wallet is a personal, offline vault for social account records, bank card records, and Philippine government ID details. It does not require an online account and does not provide cloud storage, remote authentication, payment processing, or government identity verification. This notice covers the application and information you voluntarily send to the developer for support.

INFORMATION STORED ON YOUR DEVICE
You choose what to enter. Records may contain platform names, usernames, passwords, account PINs, links between social accounts, bank and cardholder names, card numbers, expiry dates, CVVs, card PINs, and government ID details. Government ID fields depend on the document type you select. The app also stores record identifiers, creation and modification timestamps, deletion status, card presentation choices, and related local metadata needed to organize your records.
The app stores a salted PIN verifier, authentication attempt and cooldown information, your biometric preference, and an encrypted copy of the vault encryption key. Your entered app PIN is not stored as plain text. Editing drafts and loaded records can temporarily exist in application memory. Public platform icons may be cached separately from your vault information.

WHY THIS INFORMATION IS USED
Information is used locally to save and display records, search supported record fields, maintain account links and recent-item ordering, restore or permanently delete items in Trash, and control access to the vault. SQLite is the authoritative record store. The developer cannot remotely read, change, or delete your vault through the app.

OFFLINE OPERATION AND DISCLOSURE
Core features work without Internet connectivity. The application has no Internet permission, remote API, cloud synchronization, advertising SDK, or analytics service. It does not upload vault records or send automated crash reports to the developer.
This does not control services outside the application. Android, your device manufacturer, app store, keyboard, clipboard, accessibility services, or another application may handle information under their own settings and policies. Copying information or sending a support email is a separate action under your control.

LOCAL SECURITY
Vault records are encrypted at rest using SQLCipher and a randomly generated 256-bit key. That key is protected using Android Keystore; hardware-backed protection depends on the device. The encryption key is independent of your four-digit app PIN. A salted, computationally expensive PIN verifier is used to check PIN entries.
Vault screens request Android screenshot protection, and sensitive views disable app-managed state saving, autofill, and content capture where supported. These measures reduce exposure but cannot guarantee protection against a compromised device, an untrusted input method, physical observation, or information you deliberately share. They do not guarantee immediate removal of every copy from memory or storage.

PIN, BIOMETRICS, AND LOCKING
The app locks on a fresh process start and after its background grace period of 60 seconds expires. Five failed or interrupted PIN attempts start a 30-second cooldown. Repeated cooldowns increase up to 30 minutes; failed attempts do not automatically erase the vault.
Biometric unlock is optional and requires a supported, enrolled Android biometric. Android performs biometric verification and reports its result to the app. Akin Wallet does not receive or store fingerprint images or biometric templates. Changing the app PIN requires the current PIN.

RETENTION AND DELETION
Saved records remain locally until you remove them. Deleting a record moves it to Trash, where it remains available for restoration until permanently deleted. Permanent deletion removes the record and its associated links from the application database. It is not a guarantee of forensic erasure from device storage or from copies made outside the app.
Unsaved drafts are not a persistent backup and may be lost when the process ends. The application does not automatically expire saved records or Trash contents.

BACKUP AND RECOVERY LIMITS
App data is excluded from Android cloud backup and device-to-device transfer. There is no built-in vault export, cloud recovery, or developer-operated PIN reset. Previously enabled biometrics may still permit access if available, but they do not provide a replacement for the current PIN when changing it.
Uninstalling the app, clearing its storage, resetting or losing the device, or losing access to the Keystore key can make records permanently inaccessible. Keep essential original documents and necessary recovery information securely outside this application. The developer cannot recover the encryption key or restore a lost vault.

SUPPORT CORRESPONDENCE
If you email the developer, the developer and the email providers involved receive the information you choose to send, such as your address, message, and attachments. Correspondence is used to respond to your enquiry and manage the support request, and is retained only as reasonably needed for that purpose or applicable legal obligations. Do not send your app PIN, passwords, CVVs, full card numbers, or complete ID records. No support upload occurs automatically through the app.

YOUR CHOICES AND RIGHTS
You can review and edit local records, manage biometric unlock, and restore or permanently delete Trash items within the app. For personal information actually held by the developer, including support correspondence, you may request access, correction, deletion, or other rights available under applicable law by using the contact address above. Requests are subject to lawful verification and any applicable retention requirements; the developer has no remote access to your local vault.
You may raise a privacy concern with the competent regulator. In the Philippines, information about complaints and data subject rights is available from the National Privacy Commission at privacy.gov.ph.

CHANGES AND CONTACT
A revised notice may be included in a future app version, with its updated date. Material changes will be communicated as required by applicable law. This notice explains information handling; it is not a blanket consent to unrelated processing or a waiver of statutory rights. Contact: John Deniel Santos Dela Peña, johndenieldelapena97@gmail.com.

TERMS OF SERVICE
These terms govern use of Akin Wallet, developed by John Deniel Santos Dela Peña. Contact: johndenieldelapena97@gmail.com. Use the application only if you can lawfully agree to these terms or have any permission required by applicable law.

THE APPLICATION
Akin Wallet is an offline tool for organizing personal social account, bank card, and Philippine government ID records. It provides local editing, search, record previews, account links, Trash, and access controls. It does not open online accounts, authenticate with social platforms, transfer funds, process payments, verify identity, or issue official credentials.
Card and ID previews are personal references. They are not substitutes for original documents, bank-issued cards, official digital credentials, or the requirements of a bank, government agency, merchant, or other organization. The app does not establish the validity, ownership, or accuracy of entered information.

PERMISSION TO USE
Subject to these terms, you receive a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable permission to use the application on devices you own or are authorized to control. Ownership of the application is not transferred. Do not sell or misrepresent the application as your own work or redistribute it without permission, except where applicable law or an applicable third-party licence permits otherwise.

LAWFUL AND AUTHORIZED USE
Store only information you are entitled to possess and use. Respect the rights and privacy of other people and the requirements of the organizations associated with your records. Do not use the app for fraud, impersonation, unauthorized access, or other unlawful activity. Do not interfere with its security or misuse the records of others. These terms do not restrict rights that applicable law or open-source licences expressly preserve.

YOUR DEVICE AND RECORDS
You are responsible for the accuracy of entries, access to your device, and decisions to reveal, copy, or share information. Keep the device secure, protect your app PIN, and enable biometric access only when appropriate for your circumstances. Do not rely on this application as the sole copy of an essential document or the sole source of account recovery information.
The app does not connect to the institutions named in your records and does not update records when an external password, card, or document changes. You must update local entries yourself.

ACCESS AND DATA LOSS
The app uses a four-digit PIN and optional supported Android biometrics. Repeated failed or interrupted PIN attempts cause increasing cooldowns. There is no developer-operated PIN reset, vault recovery service, or built-in export or synchronization. Biometric availability can change with device settings, enrollment, and operating system behavior. Changing your PIN requires the current PIN.
App data is excluded from Android cloud backup and device transfer. Uninstallation, clearing app storage, device reset or loss, and loss of the Keystore encryption key can make records permanently inaccessible. The developer does not hold a recovery copy. Preserve necessary originals and recovery information independently.

TRASH AND PERMANENT DELETION
Deleting a record first moves it to Trash. You can restore it or permanently delete it using the available controls. Permanent deletion removes the record and its associated account links from the application database. It does not remove copies you have made elsewhere and does not guarantee forensic erasure from device storage.

PRIVACY
The Privacy Policy in Settings explains local storage, security measures, retention, and voluntary support correspondence. The app does not require an online account or Internet connectivity for its core features. The Privacy Policy is an information notice and does not waive any privacy rights provided by applicable law.

INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND THIRD PARTIES
Rights in the original application code, design, and branding remain with their respective owners. Third-party software remains subject to its own licences. Platform names, logos, bank brands, card network marks, and government document references belong to their respective owners and identify the records you choose to organize. Their inclusion does not imply sponsorship, approval, or affiliation.

AVAILABILITY AND WARRANTIES
The application is supplied as available. To the extent permitted by law, the developer does not promise uninterrupted operation, freedom from errors, compatibility with every device, recovery of lost information, or suitability for a particular purpose. Security measures reduce risks but cannot eliminate them. Nothing in these terms excludes warranties or consumer protections that cannot lawfully be excluded.

LIABILITY
To the extent permitted by applicable law, the developer is not responsible for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of the application, including losses caused by compromised devices, unauthorized disclosure by the user, or events outside the reasonable control of the developer. No provision excludes or limits liability where doing so is unlawful, including liability for fraud or other non-excludable conduct. Your non-waivable consumer and privacy rights remain unaffected.

UPDATES AND CHANGES
Future versions may include corrections or changes to supported features and these terms. Updated terms will show their revision date, and any notice or agreement required by law will be provided. A revision does not retrospectively waive accrued rights. Review the information supplied with an update before relying on it.

ENDING USE
You may stop using the application at any time. Uninstalling it or clearing its storage removes access to its locally stored vault. Before doing so, preserve any essential information by a method appropriate to its sensitivity. There is no remote account to close.

APPLICABLE LAW AND CONTACT
These terms are intended to operate consistently with Philippine law, while preserving any mandatory protections available under the laws applicable to you. They do not impose mandatory arbitration or remove access to competent courts or regulators. If a provision cannot be enforced, the remaining provisions apply to the extent permitted by law. Questions: John Deniel Santos Dela Peña, johndenieldelapena97@gmail.com.

ABOUT AKIN WALLET
Akin Wallet is a personal vault for keeping social account details, bank card records, and Philippine government ID information together on your Android device. Core features work entirely offline, without an online account, remote server, or cloud synchronization.

SOCIAL ACCOUNTS
Choose a platform from the built-in catalog and save its username, password, and account PIN when needed. Link related accounts for convenient reference. The Dashboard displays short lists at their content height and lets longer lists scroll inside the available space. Search results use the same adaptable presentation. The app does not sign in to or communicate with the platforms listed.

GOVERNMENT IDS
Store details for National ID, Driver's License, Passport, SSS, PhilHealth, and TIN records. Browse document-inspired previews in a horizontal carousel and open a record to view or edit its fields. These are personal references, not government-issued digital credentials or proof of identity. Keep your original documents.

BANK CARDS
Organize debit, credit, and prepaid card records, choose supported card network and presentation options, and browse masked previews in a horizontal carousel. Open a record to view or edit saved details. Akin Wallet does not process payments, check balances, activate cards, or communicate with your bank.

SEARCH AND ORGANIZATION
Dashboard search filters supported account, card, and ID fields locally. Passwords, account PINs, card PINs, and CVVs are excluded from Dashboard search. Selecting a result opens its record. Opening a record updates its recency, and refreshed lists start at the first position. Deleted items remain in Trash until you restore or permanently delete them.

ACCESS AND SECURITY
The local vault is encrypted using SQLCipher. Its random encryption key is protected by Android Keystore, with hardware-backed protection where the device supports it. A four-digit app PIN controls access; optional supported Android biometrics can also unlock the vault. The app starts locked and locks after a 60-second background grace period. Repeated failed or interrupted PIN attempts cause increasing cooldowns.
Vault screens request Android screenshot protection. There is no advertising or analytics service and no Internet permission. See the Privacy Policy for security limits and information handling.

SETTINGS
Settings lets you change the app PIN, manage optional biometric unlock, open Trash, and read Privacy, Terms, and About. Changing the PIN requires the current PIN. The Dashboard and Settings remain fixed portrait screens; social lists scroll internally and legal pages scroll for reading.

BEFORE YOU RELY ON THE VAULT
There is no built-in export, synchronization, developer-operated PIN reset, or recovery service. App data is excluded from Android backup and device transfer. Uninstallation, clearing storage, device loss or reset, or loss of the Keystore key can make saved information permanently inaccessible. Keep essential originals and recovery information securely outside the app.

DEVICE REQUIREMENTS
Android 8.0 or later. The interface is designed for portrait phones. Biometric unlock requires compatible hardware, an enrolled supported biometric, and your choice to enable it. No Wi-Fi or mobile data connection is required for core functionality.

COMPONENTS AND ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS
Built with Java, XML Android Views, AndroidX, Material Components, and SQLCipher. Third-party components, names, logos, and document references remain subject to the rights and licences of their owners. Akin Wallet is not endorsed by or affiliated with the platforms, banks, card networks, or government agencies represented in your records.
